title: Total Cost of Agency: Exact Attribution of Memory Injection Cost in Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2609.23790v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every node in a multi-agent large language model (LLM) workflow retrieves context from memory and injects it into its prompt, where those injected tokens are billed as input tokens at the same per-token price as the system prompt and the user query. Production observability tools report total token cost but do not separate the tokens a node generates from the tokens it is handed, so this component of the bill is invisible to the teams paying it. We introduce the Total Cost of Agency (TCA), a decomposition of multi-agent workflow cost into base prompt, inference, memory injection, miss penalty and context-accumulation components, and an exact attribution method: a two-pass, non-billable token count that measures injected tokens directly rather than estimating them from word-count proxies. translated_title: 代理总成本：多智能体LLM工作流中记忆注入成本的精确归因
translated_abstract: 在多智能体大语言模型（LLM）工作流中，每个节点都会从记忆中检索上下文并将其注入到自身的提示词中，这些被注入的令牌会以与系统提示词和用户查询相同的单价作为输入令牌计费。生产环境的可观测性工具只报告总令牌成本，但不会将节点自身生成的令牌与传递给它的令牌区分开来，因此这一成本组成部分对付费团队来说是不可见的。我们提出了代理总成本，这是一种将多智能体工作流成本分解为基础提示词、推理、记忆注入、未命中惩罚和上下文累积等组成部分的方法，并提出了一种精确归因方法：一种两遍式的、不计费的令牌计数方法，它直接测量被注入的令牌，而不是通过字数代理来估算。在一个针对真实模型API执行的200个任务的企业基准测试中，记忆注入占可变成本的13.6%，一种编译时优化……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出代理总成本（TCA）框架，将多智能体LLM工作流成本分解为基础提示词、推理、记忆注入等组件，并通过两遍式不计费令牌计数方法实现记忆注入成本的精确归因，发现记忆注入在企业基准测试中占可变成本的13.6%。
en_tdlr: Introduces Total Cost of Agency (TCA), a framework that decomposes multi-agent LLM workflow costs into components and exactly attributes memory injection cost via a two-pass, non-billable token count, revealing that memory injection accounts for 13.6% of variable cost on an enterprise benchmark.
